title: Kick-off meeting
agenda: Welcome and presentation of all partners
Project goals and the four work packages
How we work together: roles and meeting routines
The member workspace and the open platform
Plan for the first six months
notes: All ten partners took part. The partners agreed to keep documents in the member workspace and to use initiatives to follow ideas from problem to spread.

decisions.text: Partner meetings are held twice a year and rotate between the countries.
English is the working language. Local material can be in the national language with a short English summary.
No patient data is stored in the member workspace.

actions.text: Send the project handbook to all partners
Name one contact person per organisation

title: WP2 workshop: mapping local pathways
notes: Each country started its own map. The groups found it difficult to describe who is responsible for referral.

decisions.text: All pathway maps use the same five steps: diagnosis, treatment plan, referral, rehabilitation, follow-up.
Each country delivers one map. Differences between clinics are marked on the map.

actions.text: Upload first draft of the pathway map for each country
Review the pathway map from Region Skåne

title: Steering group meeting
agenda: Associated partners: status and next steps
notes: All work packages follow the plan. Three healthcare providers and two patient groups have joined as associated partners.

decisions.text: The next partner meeting is held in Gdańsk on 1 and 2 December 2027.
Associated partners are invited to 'Ask the network' and to open meetings.

actions.text: Send draft agenda for the partner meeting in Gdańsk
Approve the minutes from the steering group meeting
Contact two more patient groups in Germany and Denmark

title: WP3 workshop: planning the Academy
agenda: Six modules: content and learning goals
notes: The group agreed that the Academy is for physiotherapists, nurses and physicians who are new to exercise oncology.

decisions.text: The Academy has six modules. Each module is a 90-minute online session and one practical task.
Practice Labs are held online once a month for 45 minutes.

actions.text: Comment on the Academy curriculum outline
